title: Total EXHAUST™ Ducted Fume Hoods
meta_title: Total EXHAUST Ducted Fume Hoods - Air Science
meta_description: Air Science's Total EXHAUST ducted fume hoods provide personnel protection from hazardous agents and toxic chemicals with horizontal and vertical airflow across the work surface.
meta_keywords: ducted fume hoods, total exhaust, air science, hazardous agents, toxic chemicals, horizontal airflow, vertical airflow
short_description: Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods use horizontal and vertical airflow across the work surface to provide personnel protection from hazardous agents and toxic chemicals. These hoods are connected to the facility exhaust system.
full_description: Air Science manufactures 6 standard sizes of Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods for new and replacement installations. Custom sizes are available for special equipment or instrumentation. These hoods feature an ergonomic design with easy access and uniform non-glare lighting.
seo_content: The Total EXHAUST line of ducted fume hoods from Air Science are constructed of durable polypropylene and comply with OSHA, ISO, and ENERGY STAR standards. They are available in a range of widths from 24" to 96" to meet any specialized filtration need, including common applications in forensics, education, microscopy, pharmaceuticals, powder weighing, sample preparation, veterinary, and dental work.

Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
